english.title: Government contractor fail to take care to prevent unauthorised disclosure
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a government contractor who, by virtue of your position as such, had in your possession or under your control

(A)_[a document,]_
(B)_[an article,]_

for which it would be an offence under any of the foregoing provisions to section 8 of the Official Secrets Act 1989 for you to disclose without lawful authority and you failed to take such care to prevent the unauthorised disclosure of it, as a person in your position may reasonably be expected to take
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 8(1) and 10(2) of the Official Secrets Act 1989.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
